description: Figure 7 presents a bar chart comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa models across different language families. The chart is divided into two main sections, each representing one of the models. The x-axis categorizes the data by language family, while the y-axis measures the number of cases. The bars are color-coded, with blue representing mBERT and green representing XLM-RoBERTa. The chart shows that mBERT generally performs better than XLM-RoBERTa across most language families, with the most significant differences observed in the 'Indo-European' and 'Uralic' language families. The 'Semitic' and 'Sino-Tibetan' language families show relatively similar performance between the two models. The chart is organized in a grid format, with each language family represented by a pair of bars side by side for easy comparison.
